summary.note: every M-item demonstrates its functional requirement with committed code and tests; hardware-formal SLO runs that remain open are tracked by their own checklist items (B3, C2, D1) and named per item below

requirements.title: Audio I/O engine: realtime record/playback, configurable buffers, device hot-swap
evidence: audio-studio/audio_studio/core/engine.py (configurable block_size playback engine; AudioEngine.set_output device hot-swap)
audio-studio/tests/test_engine.py (incl. hot-swap mid-playback, dead-device survival, resume-from-playhead)
notes: hot-swap is verified against backend doubles (a working replacement and a device that fails to open): mid-playback swap resumes from the audible playhead and a dead device leaves the session intact
the 60-minute hardware recording soak is a stability SLO tracked as checklist C2, not an M1 functional gap

requirements.title: Non-destructive editing: cut/copy/paste/trim/silence/delete, undo/redo >= 100, source never rewritten in place
Waveform view: sample-level zoom, peak cache, selection/markers/loop
Spectral view: adjustable STFT, log/linear frequency axis, selection linked with the waveform view
File formats: WAV/BWF 16/24/32f/64f incl. RF64 >4GB, AIFF, FLAC; MP3/OGG read; bext preserved
evidence: audio-studio/audio_studio/core/loader.py (WAV/AIFF/FLAC read/write, MP3/OGG read, RF64/W64 decode; read_bext capture on load, bext re-attachment on save_audio)
audio-studio/tests/test_loader.py (incl. byte-for-byte bext load/save round trip; non-WAV targets refuse rather than drop the chunk)
.agent_workspace/v1.0/rf64-memory-report.json (4.4GB RF64 streamed under 1GB RSS, headless proxy)
notes: >4GB RF64 format support is demonstrated with a real 4.4GB file on the headless proxy; the dedicated-hardware run that formalises the <1GB RSS SLO stays tracked as checklist B3

requirements.title: Metering: sample peak, true peak (dBTP), RMS, EBU R128 M/S/I/LRA/TP, EBU Mode
Analysis: amplitude statistics, realtime FFT analyzer, phase correlation meter
evidence: audio-studio/audio_studio/dsp/correlation.py (phase_correlation one-shot measurement; CorrelationMeter streaming needle with ~300 ms ballistics)
audio-studio/tests/test_correlation.py (identity/inverted/quadrature/uncorrelated readings, level independence, block-size-independent ballistics)

requirements.title: Basic effects: gain, peak normalize, loudness normalize (R128 target), fades, parametric EQ, compressor, true-peak limiter, noise gate
Noise reduction: noise-print spectral subtraction, previewable, adjustable strength
Sample-rate / bit-depth conversion: high-quality SRC plus TPDF-dithered bit-depth conversion
evidence: audio-studio/audio_studio/core/loader.py (quantize_with_tpdf; resample with selectable soxr VHQ quality)
.agent_workspace/v1.0/tpdf-spectrum-report.json (error RMS at LSB/2 theory, white error spectrum, no harmonic spurs)

requirements.title: Cross-platform: Windows/macOS/Linux builds and smoke tests; native backend abstraction
evidence: tools/accessibility_walkthrough_windows.py (Windows UIA/NVDA Speech Viewer host harness with honest prerequisite gate)
tools/accessibility_walkthrough_macos.py (macOS VoiceOver/AX API gated roadmap stub)
notes: cross-platform assistive-technology roadmap: run the Windows harness on an interactive Windows + NVDA host; complete the documented AX focus driver and supported/operator-confirmed utterance capture before the macOS harness may claim VoiceOver evidence
the committed D4 report currently counts only the live Linux/Orca run; the Windows and macOS harnesses do not turn UIA/AX inspection or an unsupported host into a screen-reader pass

requirements.title: Professional UI skeleton: dockable panels, dark theme, HiDPI, full shortcut coverage, 60fps refresh
evidence: audio-studio/audio_studio/ui/main_window.py (dockable panels, workspace presets, saveState/restoreState; UI_REFRESH_MS = 16, one 60 Hz frame)
tests/acceptance/test_sota_checklist.py::D2/D3/D5 (dock persistence, keyboard workflow, UI scaling: PASS)
notes: the skeleton refreshes playhead/meters at 60 Hz over a cached waveform pixmap; the measured p99 frame-time and HiDPI 2x capture on real display hardware stays tracked as checklist D1

requirements.title: Testing and verification: DSP golden-file regression, EBU 3341/3342 vectors, bit-exact null test
